children: Shares of Silvia were up after the stock began trading on Nasdaq under its new ticker, reflecting the rebranding of the company formerly known as ProCap Financial.
The stock, now trading under the ticker SVIA, was up 20% at $4.89 in trading midday Tuesday. Shares previously traded under the symbol BRR.

The company last week said it was rebranding from ProCap to Silvia, the name of its platform for developing artificial-intelligence agents focused on finance and delivering them to independent investors. It described itself on Tuesday as "the first publicly traded agentic finance firm."
The company also changed the address of its website to reflect the name change, and said the ticker for its warrants was also changed to SVIAW from BRRWW.
